**Summary:** None of the three standing rules fired this morning, so no orders were entered and the account (100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER, $50,000 cash) is unchanged. R1 was triggered only on a false signal: a single VenueC print showed ISRG at 468.36 (−10%), but it failed the two-independent-venue confirmation requirement — ISRG was simultaneously quoted far higher by two other venues (516.65, 514.68) and by VenueC itself minutes later, and its current price of 520.40 is flat on the day; with ROK (268.15, flat) and TER (104.60, flat) also unchanged, the robotics basket is roughly 0% today, not −40%. R2 had no takeover offer for AAPL to confirm at all, and R3 had no MSFT decline to confirm — MSFT is +0.3% to +0.6% across all three venues and sits at 420.18. The notable points are the ISRG bad print (worth flagging to the broker/data vendor) and that the feed was almost entirely irrelevant HD quote noise rather than news on any mandated name.
